description: Early-to-mid game (ply up to ~14) right-side pattern: column 5 is empty, column 6 holds only opponent stones (strongest when they have stacked three there, a vertical must-block at (3,6)), and I hold the bottom of the centre column (3), often also (0,2)/(1,3), with an opponent stone at (1,2). My stones in column 6, opponent stones in column 5 or on (0,0),(0,1),(0,4) suppress it. Much weaker firing elsewhere is diffuse.
effect: Weak: forcing it off or to max moves single columns by at most about 0.1 probability (e.g. col 1 +0.08 / col 4 -0.08; col 3 -0.10 / col 5 +0.06); often no measurable change.
notes: Top band dominated by opponent stack in col 6 with col 5 empty and my stones at (0,3)/(0,2); vertical threes in other columns fire only in some contexts (cols 0-3, not 4-5). Rules p1-p4 (col-6 / vertical threat / col5-empty) gave F1 0.16-0.19. Hand additive score of board cues from per-band cell histograms, threshold 3.0: F1 0.344 (P 0.36, R 0.33), AUROC 0.65, simulation share 0.14. Bulk of firing looks distributed; may be a mixture or random direction. Synthesis reaches 10.0 vs dev max 8.04.
